question: Do title and risk of loss for the equipment pass to the buyer at the same time?
ground_truth_answer: No. Title passes to Buyer upon receipt of full payment, while risk of loss passes to Buyer upon delivery — these are two different events, and delivery occurs before full payment is complete under the payment schedule in Clause 1.

expected_citations.section: Clause 5 - Title and Risk of Loss
expected_citations.span_hint: Title to the Equipment passes to Buyer upon receipt of full payment
